subject: Capybara adult
description: Rounded barrel body, blunt muzzle, tiny ears, warm caramel coat

subject: Capybara baby
description: Smaller rounded muzzle and short legs. Nestle beside parent and make short follow bursts.

subject: Red panda adult
description: Rust-red fur, cream face markings, black legs, long ringed tail

subject: Red panda baby
description: Fluffy round head, soft ringed tail. Follow a low branch route and curl beside parent.

subject: Asian small-clawed otter adult
description: Long flexible brown body, cream chin, short legs and expressive whiskers

subject: Asian small-clawed otter baby
description: Shorter body and tail, cream chin. Stay near dry den, nuzzle and practise paddling.

subject: African penguin adult
description: Black back, white belly with dark chest band, short flippers and pink eye patches

subject: African penguin baby
description: Fluffy grey chick with dark bill. No adult banding. Wobble and nest beside parent.

subject: Meerkat adult
description: Small sandy upright body, dark eye patches and a slender tail

subject: Meerkat baby
description: Tiny sandy pup with dark eye patches. Peek out of burrow and copy a lookout pose.

subject: Fennec fox adult
description: Very large pointed ears, tiny cream-sand body and dark nose

subject: Fennec fox baby
description: Tiny cream kit with oversized ears. Curl near den and make a small playful pounce.

subject: Domestic rabbit adult
description: Soft round body, long upright ears, cream and caramel patches, small cotton tail

subject: Domestic rabbit baby
description: Round fluffy kit, shorter ears. Tiny hops and sibling snuggle.

subject: Pygmy goat adult
description: Compact stocky goat, short horns, little beard and cream-brown coat

subject: Pygmy goat baby
description: Small kid with short horns or horn buds. Springy hop and short parent-follow walk.

subject: Alpaca adult
description: Long neck, fluffy cream fleece, small pointed ears and rounded muzzle

subject: Alpaca baby
description: Fluffy cria with long thin legs and larger head. Gentle follow and curious ear twitch.

subject: Aldabra giant tortoise adult
description: Large domed charcoal shell, sturdy scaled legs and gentle wrinkled head

subject: Aldabra giant tortoise baby
description: Tiny hatchling with a domed shell. Slow independent exploration near a safe retreat.

subject: Chilean flamingo adult
description: Pale pink plumage, long slender legs, curved pink neck and black-tipped bill

subject: Chilean flamingo baby
description: Grey-white fluffy chick with short bill and legs, not a pink miniature adult. Nest wobble.

subject: Indian peafowl adult
description: Royal-blue neck, small crown crest and emerald eye-spotted male train

subject: Indian peafowl baby
description: Tan-brown peachick, no display train. Short quick follow steps. Adult female requires separate brown-plumage art.

subject: Ring-tailed lemur adult
description: Grey body, white face, black eye mask and long black-and-white ringed tail

subject: Ring-tailed lemur baby
description: Small grey infant with large eyes and ringed tail. Cling or stay close to parent.

subject: Two-toed sloth adult
description: Shaggy tan body, rounded dark eye mask and two prominent hooked foreclaws

subject: Two-toed sloth baby
description: Small fluffy infant with round face. Cling to parent and practise tiny leaf reaches.

subject: Malayan tapir adult
description: Rounded black body with broad white saddle, short flexible snout and small white-rimmed ears

subject: Malayan tapir baby
description: Brown calf with cream stripes and spots. Do not use the adult white saddle. Follow and sniff.

subject: African elephant adult
description: Large grey rounded body, broad ears, long trunk and clear weight-bearing legs

subject: African elephant baby
description: Round calf with short trunk and no long adult tusks. Trunk wobble and parent follow.

subject: Giraffe adult
description: Tall tan neck, warm brown patches, small ossicones and long elegant legs

subject: Giraffe baby
description: Small calf with long thin legs and shorter neck proportions. Careful steps and curious head tilt.

subject: Plains zebra adult
description: Compact equine body, bold black-and-white stripes and short upright mane

subject: Plains zebra baby
description: Small foal with large ears and shorter muzzle. Soft juvenile stripe treatment and follow walk.

subject: Arctic fox adult
description: Compact fox with small rounded ears, plush white winter coat and thick fluffy tail

subject: Arctic fox baby
description: Round fluffy kit with short muzzle and small ears. Tiny pounce and parent-side nap.

subject: Snow leopard adult
description: Pale grey spotted coat, thick long tail, broad paws and rounded ears

subject: Snow leopard baby
description: Round cub with oversized paws and long soft tail. Low-ledge play and parent-side tail curl.
